description: Document roles and real execution scope for every chip/family currently referenced by ChipSim. Empty roles and missing downloads are explicit.

chips.title: RP2040 / PIO
chips.nativeProgramming: PIO assembly; Arm Thumb firmware requires a separate CPU backend.
chips.scope: One original semantic PIO transfer example; no custom native instruction loader yet.

chips.title: AM335x / PRU
chips.nativeProgramming: PRU assembly; Arm firmware is a different execution target.
chips.scope: Direct R30/R31 semantic transfer example; not a full PRU ISA or AM335x emulator.

chips.title: S32K144 / FlexIO
chips.nativeProgramming: C/C++ host firmware configures FlexIO registers; FlexIO itself has no CPU instruction stream.
chips.scope: Shifter/timer teaching scenario; arbitrary FlexIO register configurations are not yet executable.

chips.title: PSoC 5LP / UDB
chips.nativeProgramming: PSoC Creator hardware/datapath configuration plus Cortex-M3 firmware.
chips.scope: Composed UDB teaching network; no fitter, routing compiler or Cortex-M3 firmware execution.

chips.title: XMOS xCORE / XS3
chips.nativeProgramming: xC/C/C++ compiled for the XS3 ISA; xsim is the vendor simulator.
chips.scope: One timed-port teaching scenario; no XE executable loading or native ISA backend.

chips.title: eTPU (MPC5554 as a device reference)
chips.nativeProgramming: eTPU C compiled to microengine code; host Power Architecture firmware is a separate target.
chips.scope: Match/capture channel teaching example; no eTPU microcode execution.

missing.title: Enhanced Time Processing Unit Reference Manual (ETPURM)
missing.reason: Skipped at the user's request. NXP lists ETPURM Rev. 1 as Account Required; the full manual is not bundled. Public application notes remain the references for the existing teaching model.

chips.title: 74HC595 / 74HCT595
chips.nativeProgramming: No CPU or firmware. Supply data, shift/storage clocks, reset and output enable.
chips.scope: Reviewed shift/storage-register profile; no analog/timing model.

chips.title: 74HC00
chips.nativeProgramming: No CPU or native program. A host experiment drives the documented input pins.
chips.scope: Data-derived supported function-table model; consult the generated model for instance mapping and limitations.
